name: @danielsimonjr/mathts-workerpool
description: Worker pool management for MathTS parallel computations
author: Daniel Simon Jr.

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/worker.ts --format esm --clean && tsc -p tsconfig.dts.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.dev: tsup src/index.ts src/worker.ts --format esm --watch --onSuccess "tsc -p tsconfig.dts.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs"
scripts.build:prod: tsup src/index.ts src/worker.ts --format esm --clean --minify --treeshake && tsc -p tsconfig.dts.json && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
